conn.title: Connect to a Medialect server
conn.h: The app can download the data itself, or show the catalogue of your Medialect server (Docker). Enter the server's address and a password: the admin password also opens the server's settings, the connection password only the catalogue. Away from home the app uses the public address set on the server.

conn.iconHome: Connected to the Medialect server (home address)

wiz.mode.h: How do you want to use Medialect?
wiz.mode.alone.h: The app downloads and rates the catalogue itself.
wiz.mode.server.h: The catalogue of your server (Docker); the app downloads nothing.
acc.connect.h: The app connects with the server's address and a password. The admin password opens everything, the connection password only the catalogue. Without a login the server shows nothing.
acc.publicUrl.h: The address the server is reachable at from outside (over HTTPS, e.g. a reverse proxy). The app uses it away from home.
acc.viewer.h: Optional. Whoever logs in with it sees the catalogue but not the settings.
acc.viewerRemoveConfirm: Logins with this password stop working. Continue?
srv.key.emby: An administrator creates the key in Emby: Dashboard (Manage Emby Server) → Advanced → API Keys → + New Api Key. Name it e.g. Medialect and copy it.
srv.key.jellyfin: An administrator creates the key in Jellyfin: Dashboard → API Keys → +. Name it e.g. Medialect and copy it.
srv.key.plex: Find the token in Plex Web: on any title ⋯ → Get Info → View XML; it is in the address of the page that opens, after X-Plex-Token=.

set.title: Catalogue settings
set.intro: Where the catalogue and its ratings come from. Changes take effect after you press “Save catalogue settings” below.
set.country.h: Which country's streaming catalogues to load. Catalogues differ by country.
set.language.h: The language JustWatch returns titles in. Titles from your own libraries are not changed.
set.interval.h: How often all sources and ratings are refreshed automatically.
set.jw.h: Free, no key. Loads the full catalogues of the selected services including video and audio quality and languages.
set.jw.delay.h: A higher value puts less load on JustWatch but the sync takes longer.
set.jw.providers.h: Tap a service to select or remove it. Selected ones come first; hold and drag a tile to change the order (on TV: OK, arrows, OK) – titles in the catalogue list services in this order.
set.sa.h: Paid service with a free tier. Gives more precise links straight to the title and the date the service added it.
set.sa.mode.h: Depends on where you got the key: directly from movieofthenight.com or via RapidAPI.
set.sa.key.h: Without a key this source is skipped.
set.sa.budget.h: When used up, the walk stops and continues the next day where it left off.
set.sa.catalogs.h: Services to take Streaming Availability data for.
set.r.imdb.h: Free. Downloaded once a day; rates every title with an IMDb ID.
set.r.jw.h: Fills in TMDB and Rotten Tomatoes only where no other source has them.
set.r.csfd.h: Read from the ČSFD website (it has no API) with a 1.5 s pause between requests.
set.r.tmdb.h: Free at themoviedb.org (Settings → API). Adds TMDB ratings.
set.r.omdb.h: Free at omdbapi.com. Adds Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic.
set.r.omdbBudget.h: A free key allows 1,000 requests per day.
set.r.mdb.h: Optional. Adds Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Letterboxd and Trakt.
set.r.mdbBudget.h: A free key allows 1,000 requests per day.
set.r.refresh.h: After how many days a title's ratings are loaded again.
